lines.state: Your <label> has an overdue amount of <due> and is <days_late> days overdue.
lines.a1_full: I understand. For your <label>, could you pay the full overdue amount of <due> on <end_of_week>?
lines.a1_floor: I understand. For your <label>, could you pay <floor> on <end_of_week>? The remainder stays overdue.
lines.floor_b: I understand. The lowest amount I can accept for your <label> is <floor>; the remainder stays overdue. Could you pay <floor>?
lines.a2: I understand. For your <label>, could you pay <floor> on <deadline>? The remainder stays overdue.
lines.a2_date: I understand. Could you make that payment on <deadline> instead?

debt_statement.prefix: I am calling from the collections team about overdue payments.
debt_statement.suffix: Are you able to pay all of this today?
debt_statement.suffix_one: Are you able to pay all of this today?
